name: foreach_ids
description: Normative ForEach row/child/key-child id derivation (D1/D2). Single source of truth; both host kits load this vector file and assert identical ids.
row_id: fnv1a-32: start=0x811c9dc5; foreach_id u32 LE; 0x2C marker byte; index_or_key u64 LE (use splice key when present, else row index); multiply 0x0100_0193 after each byte; final u32 OR 0x8000_0000
child_id: fnv1a-32: start=0x811c9dc5; row_id u64 LE; 0x3F marker byte; orig_id u64 LE; multiply 0x0100_0193 after each byte; final u32 OR 0xC000_0000
key_child_id: fnv1a-32: start=0x811c9dc5; row_id u64 LE; 0x3F marker byte; splice_key u64 LE; multiply 0x0100_0193 after each byte; final u32 OR 0xC000_0000

markers.note: final u32 result ORed with the marker; derived ids are always >= 0x8000_0000 so they never collide with real server node ids (< 0x8000_0000)
